title: Vesper and the Parish
author: Edmund Reyes
blurb: Ivo Almeida, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
